urls.current_mutiny_text: Mutiny is an AI agent for go-to-market teams. It builds customer-facing content—pitch decks, business cases, pricing proposals, competitive one-pagers, and deal rooms—from scratch for each account. Originally a website-personalization tool, it relaunched in April 2026 around a single agent that reps can prompt directly. ... Pricing: Free plan available. Paid Business and Enterprise tiers, with Enterprise starting around $30K/year.

company_context: Dock (Dock Labs, Inc.) sells an AI revenue enablement platform: digital sales rooms / buyer workspaces, mutual action plans, AI content library (CMS), LMS/playbooks, AI agents, Dock MCP, order forms, client portals. Small VC-backed startup founded 2021 by Alex Kracov (CEO, ex-VP Marketing at Lattice). Content + SEO is described by Dock as its #1 acquisition channel; the 'Revenue Lab' library is a large set of '[competitor] alternatives' listicles that Dock refreshes often. Dock writes these pages to rank Dock #1 against Seismic/Highspot/Showpad, and Mutiny is listed as a competitor in all three.

primary_contact.why: All three pages carry only 'The Dock Team' byline. Eric has run Dock's content/SEO program (one-person content team for years) and owns the library, so he is the person who can edit them. Still at Dock as of 2026 (now Head of Marketing).

backup_contact.why: Founder of a small startup who started Dock's content engine and still hosts the Grow & Tell podcast; marketing-minded founder who can push a quick edit if Eric doesn't respond.

update_signals: Very high refresh cadence: all three pages updated in 2026 (Jul 13, Jul 16, Sep 2, 2026), titles carry '2026', and Seismic page already reflects the Feb 2026 Seismic-Highspot merger. They already updated Mutiny once after the April 2026 relaunch (new 'AI agent / agentic' description, MCP, Free/Business/Enterprise tiers), so they track Mutiny closely; only the Enterprise price ($30K) and ABM-first framing are stale. No Dock-authored AEO/GEO post found via search, but the pages are clearly built for AI-answer extraction (TL;DR tables, 'Best for' lines).
personal_hook: Eric Doty has been a guest on Superpath's 'Content, Briefly' podcast multiple times (e.g. Ep. 85, Dec 2024: Dock's content plans incl. 'SEO component at Dock' and lessons from a one-person team) and was Superpath Head of Community. A June 24, 2026 podcast listing names him 'Head of Marketing' (episode content not verified).
likelihood_reason: Dock refreshes these pages constantly and already rewrote Mutiny's entry once, so a price fix is a 2-minute edit for them; but Dock is a direct DSR competitor, and a higher Mutiny Enterprise price arguably helps Dock's '$350/month' contrast, so they may fix the price but not soften the competitive framing.
persuasion_angle: Accuracy and credibility of their own comparison: 'Your pages already reflect our April 2026 relaunch, thanks for that. One number is out of date: Enterprise starts at $40,000/yr (Business from $50/mo), and pricing is public at mutinyhq.com/pricing, so the Highspot page line "not publicly listed" is also wrong.' Keep it purely factual (price + public pricing + 'AI sales assistant' category); don't ask them to change rank or positioning. Note AI engines quote these lines verbatim (this domain has ~940 Peec retrievals across the 3 URLs), so a wrong price hurts the reader's trust in Dock's guide too.
